1. Load station data
2. Load UVP6 and CTD data to get max tow depths
3. Calculate % of bottom depth with cast

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggrepel)
```

# 1. Load station data from Excel
```{r, eval=FALSE}
stns_2021 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2021_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = "darkedge") %>% 
  select(-`UTC\r\nTime`)
stns_2023 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2023_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = "amundsen_2023")
stns_2024 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2024_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = paste0("am_leg", Leg))

stns_meta <- bind_rows(stns_2021, stns_2023, stns_2024)
rm(stns_2021, stns_2023, stns_2024)

# Export this data frame to append the station name formating that matches UVP6.
write.csv(file = "data/Amundsen_stations_list.csv",
          stns_meta, row.names = F)
```

# 2. Load UVP6 and CTD data
```{r}
load("data/uvp6_CNN_segmentations_morphotraits_20251208.RData")
rm(all.copepods.uvp6)

stns_meta <- read.csv("data/Amundsen_stations_list_ed20251201.csv") %>% 
  select(sample_cruise = Cruise,  
         sample_stationid = station_id,
         Amund_Station_ID = Station.ID,
         bottom_depth_m = `Depth..m.`) %>% 
  filter(sample_stationid != "") %>% 
  # Choose max depth
  group_by(sample_cruise, sample_stationid) %>% 
  mutate(bottom_depth_m = max(bottom_depth_m)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(sample_cruise, sample_stationid, .keep_all = T)

# Add bottom depth to Amund_UVP metadata
Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  # For 2021 darkedge, the station id is only the first segment
  mutate(sample_stationid_ed = if_else(sample_cruise == "darkedge",
                                       str_extract(sample_id, "^[^_]+"), 
                                       sample_stationid)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_stationid_ed = if_else(sample_id == "de_bb2_float",
                                       "de_bb2_float", sample_stationid_ed)) %>% 
  
  
  left_join(stns_meta, 
            by = join_by(sample_cruise, 
                         sample_stationid_ed == sample_stationid))

# 26 stations have no bottom depth information
nodepth <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(is.na(bottom_depth_m))
```

# 3. Match stations
```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta, aes(x = maxSampleDepth, y = bottom_depth_m)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sample_cruise)) +
  geom_abline()

# Check samples with max tow depth not within 100 m of bottom depth

tocheck_depth <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(maxSampleDepth > bottom_depth_m + 100 |
           maxSampleDepth < bottom_depth_m - 100 |
           is.na(bottom_depth_m)) %>% 
  mutate(perc_diff = maxSampleDepth / bottom_depth_m * 100) %>% 
  relocate(sample_cruise, sample_stationid, 
           maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m, perc_diff)

ggplot(tocheck_depth, aes(x = maxSampleDepth, y = bottom_depth_m)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sample_cruise)) +
  geom_abline() 

# TODO figure out what to do with these samples
```

# 4. Plot profile groups
```{r, width = 12}
region_rename <- data.frame(
  region = c("Baffin Bay", "Baffin Shelf", 
             "Davis Strait", "Lancaster Sound",
             "North Water Polynya", "Labrador Shelf", 
             "Greenland Shelf", "Nares Strait"),
  region.inuktitut = c("Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
                       "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
                       "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
                       "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
                       "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
                       "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)",
                       "Kalaallit Nunaat Shelf\n(Greenland Shelf)", 
                       "Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)"),
  region.color = c("goldenrod2","purple2","turquoise2","forestgreen",
                   "deeppink1","red","blue1", "sienna2")) %>% 
  # order regions as factors by latitude
  mutate(region.inuktitut = factor(
    region.inuktitut,
    levels = c("Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)",
               "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
               "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
               "Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
               "Kalaallit Nunaat Shelf\n(Greenland Shelf)", 
               "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)"
    ))) %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut)

clrs <- unique(region_rename$region.color)

# TODO temporary and need to delete
profiles_list <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "ECOPART_summary") %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(year(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`))) %>% 
  filter(!(region %in% c("Ungava Bay", "St Lawrence"))) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename, by = "region") %>% 
  # Add month and year
  mutate(Month = month(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`, label = T),
         DOY = yday(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`))
  
update_profile_groups <- profiles_list %>% 
  group_by(cruise_name, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  count() 

# Number of profiles and profile groups by region
update_profile_groups %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n_profilegroups = n(),
            n_profiles = sum(n),
            .groups = "drop")
# TODO plot all 7 cruises, same color-symbol per profile_group [ label sampling period]
# TODO set bottom depth as max and mean+-sd


basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,54,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = profiles_list,
                                aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                                    shape = Year,
                                    color = region.inuktitut),
                                size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs, name = "Region") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.position = c(0.05, 0.05), 
        legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(6,6,6,6),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("figures/samples_map_by_region_v2.png", width = 6, height = 8,
       units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# 5. Temporal plots
```{r}
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,54,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  #bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = profiles_list,
                                aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                                    shape = Month,
                                    fill = DOY),
                                size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", direction = -1,
                       breaks = c(182, 213, 244, 274),
                       labels = c("Jul 1","Aug 1","Sep 1","Oct 1")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,24)) +
  facet_wrap(~Year)

# ggsave("figures/samples_map_by_dates_v2.png", width = 13, height = 6,
#        units = "in", bg = "white")

ggplot(profiles_list, aes(x = DOY, y = Year,
                          color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs)

# Number of casts per month by region
ggplot(profiles_list, aes(x = Month, fill = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_histogram(stat = "count", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs, name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  ylab("N UVP6 profiles") 

ggsave("figures/sample_dist_by_month.png",
       width = 9, height = 4, units = "in", bg = "white")

ggplot(profiles_list, aes(x = Year, fill = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_histogram(stat = "count", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs, name = "Region") +
  ylab("N UVP6 profiles") 


```



# 6. Inspect profiles for organizing profile_groups
## 2021 Dark Edge
```{r, eval=FALSE}
df_subset <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise == "darkedge")

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        # limits = c(-90,-50,64,83), rotate = T,
        limits = c(-90,-60,74,80), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    color = sample_id),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Plot the labels
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    label = sample_stationid_ed,
                                    color = sample_id),
                                max.overlaps = 20, size = 2) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5))

# Plot casts depths chronologically
ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = object_date, y = maxSampleDepth,
           color = sample_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 2, max.repel = 20)
  

ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = sample_id, y = maxSampleDepth, color = object_date)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = maxSampleDepth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(aes(y = bottom_depth_m), color = "red", shape = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

### Check Darkedge profile depths
```{r}
de.check <- segmented.images %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise == "darkedge") %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(min_samp_depth = min(object_depth_max),
            max_samp_depth = max(object_depth_max),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta, by = join_by(sample_id))

colnames(de.check)

ggplot(de.check, aes(x = sample_id, y = bottom_depth_m)) +
  geom_point(color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min_samp_depth, ymax = max_samp_depth),
                color = "blue") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_reverse()
```
